note: Environment VARIABLE NAMES are recorded; values are deliberately omitted. Some env values may be sensitive and a committed snapshot is the wrong place for them. To restore an environment, read it live at rollback time.
rollback_procedure: Each function is invoked through its `live` alias, so rollback is a pointer move, not a redeploy. Prior versions are immutable and retained. For each function below: aws lambda update-alias --function-name <function> --name live --function-version <live_alias_version>. Verify afterwards with GetAlias that FunctionVersion matches and that State is Active.
